blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Face swapping transfers a source identity onto a target image while preserving the target's pose, expression, hair, and lighting. The most realistic current methods are diffusion-based, but they need many network evaluations per image. GAN-based methods are fast, yet trained from scratch they must learn realism from the adversarial signal alone and produce visibly weaker results. We present ALADDIN (Adversarial Latent Diffusion Distillation for One-Step Identity Swapping), a one-step face swapper obtained by initialising the generator from a pre-trained multi-step flow-matching model and training it adversarially under identity and target-preservation constraints. We expose a controllable trade-off between identity transfer and target-attribute preservation by training a student model with triplet pseudo-label supervision. We additionally identify a bias in the standard evaluation protocol, which favours methods trained against the same identity encoder used to score them, and re-evaluate all baselines with an independent one. ALADDIN is state-of-the-art among one-step methods in realism and target preservation at comparable identity transfer, and matches the best multi-step model with 28 times fewer network evaluations and an order of magnitude fewer training pairs.
blocks.zh: 面相相互换将源身份传递到目标图像上,同时保留目标姿势,表情,发型和照明. 目前最现实的方法都是以传播为基础的,但是每个图像都需要许多网络评价. 以全球网络为基础的方法很快,但从零开始训练,它们必须仅从对抗信号中学习现实主义,并产生明显较弱的结果。 我们提出ALADDIN(Aversarial Lententnt Difusion Distillation for One-Step Independence Swapping),这是通过从预先训练的多步相容模型初始化发电机并在身份和目标保护限制下进行对抗性训练而获得的一步相容交换机. 我们通过培训三重假标签监督的学生模型,在身份转移和目标属性保存之间暴露出可控的取舍. 此外,我们还发现标准评价协议中存在偏差,它倾向于使用同一身份编码器对经过培训的方法进行评级,并用独立的编码重新评价所有基线。 ALADDIN是现实主义中最先进的一步方法,在可比较的身份传递时是目标保存,并且与最佳多步模式相匹配,网络评价减少28倍,培训对等数量级也减少.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The goal of face swapping is to transfer the source human identity
onto a target face image while keeping the target’s attributes intact: background, hair, pose, expression, lighting, and accessories.
An example of a face swap application is shown in Figure 1 .
The task has broad relevance across various areas, for example,
film production [ 35 ] and privacy protection [ 50 ] .

换脸的目的是转移源头人类身份
在目标面部图像上,同时保持目标属性完整:背景、头发、姿势、表情、照明和附件。
面额互换应用程序的一个例子见图1。
这项任务在各个领域具有广泛的相关性,例如:
电影制作[35]和隐私保护[50].

blocks.en: Early systems were limited to existing collections of faces [ 3 ] or required manual intervention [ 5 ] , whereas modern approaches learn the swap with neural networks.
blocks.zh: 早期系统仅限于现有的面孔集合[3]或需要人工干预[5],而现代方法学习与神经网络的互换.

blocks.en:
Many prominent face-swapping methods are built on the Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) [ 16 ] framework.
GAN-based face-swapping methods can be broadly categorised into two families: direct and inversion-based .
Direct methods, including SimSwap [ 7 ] , HifiFace [ 49 ] , FaceDancer [ 39 ] , and InfoSwap [ 13 ] , train a swapping generator end to end with identity, attribute-preservation, and adversarial objectives.
Inversion-based methods, such as MegaFS [ 57 ] and E4S [ 34 ] manipulate the latent representation of a pretrained StyleGAN generator [ 27 , 28 ] . However, GANs suffer from unstable training and usually produce less realistic results [ 11 ] than diffusion-based models [ 21 , 44 , 32 ] .
blocks.zh:
许多突出的面部切换方法都建立在基因反面网络(GAN)[16]框架之上.
以GAN为基础的面部拓扑方法可以大致分为两个家族:直接的和反演的.
直接方法,包括SimSwap [7],HifiFace [49],FaceDancer [39],以及InfoSwap [13],训练一个互换生成器端端以身份,属性保护,以及对抗目标结束.
基于倒置的方法,如MegaFS [57]和E4S [34] 操纵一个预先训练的StyleGAN生成器的潜在代表[27,28]. 然而,GANs受到的训练不稳定,通常产生的实际效果不如基于传播的模式[21,44,32].

blocks.en:
Diffusion modelling is another paradigm for image generation with a more stable training compared to GANs, but comes at a higher training and inference cost. One requires tens of neural function evaluations (NFE) to generate an image with a diffusion model, while GAN inference requires just a single NFE. Diffusion models for face swapping were developed in [ 29 , 56 , 2 , 18 , 52 , 26 ] .
Since diffusion models suffer from high inference cost, a lot of diffusion distillation techniques were developed recently [ 45 , 33 , 42 , 41 , 53 , 54 , 15 ] to combine high quality generation with a low inference cost.
blocks.zh:
传播建模是图像生成的另一种范式,与GANs相比训练更加稳定,但以更高的培训和推论成本出现. 一个需要数十个神经功能评价(NFE)来生成带有扩散模型的图像,而GAN推论只需要一个单一的NFE. [29,56,2,18,52,26] 开发了面相交换的传播模式.
由于传播模型受到高推论成本的影响,最近开发了许多传播蒸馏技术[45,33,42,41,53,54,15],将高质量生成与低推论成本结合起来.

blocks.en:
In our paper, we combine the high realism of diffusion models with one-step GAN inference: we initialise the generator from a pre-trained diffusion model and train it adversarially with a discriminator that reads diffusion features, a design introduced by adversarial diffusion distillation [ 42 , 41 ] and adopted as an auxiliary loss by improved distribution matching distillation [ 54 , 53 ] .
Our main contributions are: 1. We present ALADDIN: A dversarial LA tent D iffusion D istillation for one-step I dentity swappi N g, a simple method that achieves state-of-the-art quality among one-step models. 2. We outperform almost every multi-step baseline and achieve the same quality as the state-of-the-art diffusion model, APPLE [ 26 ] . Our model requires an order of magnitude fewer training pairs than APPLE and 28× fewer network evaluations at inference. 3. We identify a positive bias in identity similarity estimation in the prior evaluation protocols and address it by re-evaluating all baselines with an independent identity model.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Early neural face-swapping methods predominantly relied on GANs and could be broadly divided into direct generator-based and GAN-inversion approaches.
Direct methods train a swapping network to combine the source identity with target attributes.
SimSwap [ 7 ] introduces an ID-injection module and a weak feature-matching loss to improve identity transfer while preserving target attributes.
InfoSwap [ 13 ] uses information-bottleneck objectives and an identity-contrastive loss to disentangle source identity from target-specific information.
HiFiFace [ 49 ] incorporates 3D shape and semantic priors to improve face-shape transfer and geometric consistency,
while FaceDancer [ 39 ] employs adaptive feature-fusion attention and identity feature refinement to improve robustness to pose variation and occlusion.
InSwapper [ 48 ] is a widely used direct model whose training procedure is undocumented.
CSCS [ 22 ] uses two surrogate generators to synthesise a source and a target from one real image, which then serves as the ground-truth swap.
Trained from scratch, direct methods must learn realism from the adversarial signal alone while the identity and attribute objectives compete with it, and they produce local artifacts under large pose, shape, or occlusion changes.
blocks.zh:
早期的神经面部拓扑方法主要依赖GAN,大致可以分为直接生成器和GAN反射法两种.
直接方法训练一个互换网络,将源身份与目标属性相结合.
SimSwap [7]引入了ID-注射模块和弱特性匹配损失,以改善身份传输,同时保留目标属性.
InfoSwap [13] 使用信息-bottleneck目标以及身份-连锁损失从目标特定信息中分离出源身份.
HiFiFace [49] 包含3D形状和语义前缀,以提高面部形状转移和几何一致性,
FaceDancer [39] 则采用适应性特征集成关注和特征特征改进,以提高强性,形成变异和隔离.
InSwapper [48]是一个被广泛使用的直接模式,其培训程序没有记录.
CSCS [22] 使用两个代用发电机从一个真实图像合成一个源和一个目标,然后作为地面-真实交换.
从零开始训练,直接的方法必须仅从对抗信号中学习现实主义,而身份和属性目标则与之竞争,它们会以大的姿势,形状,或隔离变化来生产本地文物.

blocks.en:
The second branch exploits the high-resolution image prior of a pretrained StyleGAN.
MegaFS [ 57 ] encodes source and target into an extended StyleGAN2 latent space, blends their high-level codes with a face-transfer module while keeping the target’s low-level codes, and decodes the result with the frozen generator.
E4S [ 34 ] reenacts the source into the target’s pose and expression, represents each face by per-region style codes and a segmentation mask, and swaps only the inner-face regions.
These methods inherit the realism of StyleGAN but also its limits: each face must first be embedded into an extended latent space, where an embedding either loses identity detail or leaves the well-behaved region in which the generator was trained [ 47 , 38 ] .
blocks.zh:
第二分支在预训StyleGAN之前利用高分辨率图像.
MegaFS [57] 将源码和目标编码为扩展的StyleGAN2潜伏空间,在保持目标低级代码的同时,将他们的高级代码与面传模块混合,并将结果与冷冻生成器解码.
E4S [34] 将源重新引入目标的位置和表达,通过每个区域的样式代码和一个分区面具来代表每个面孔,并且只交换内面区域.
这些方法继承了StyleGAN的现实主义,但也有其局限性:每个面部必须首先嵌入一个扩展的潜伏空间,其中嵌入者要么失去身份细节,要么离开训练生成者时表现良好的区域[47,38].

blocks.en:
Diffusion-based face swapping methods Diffusion models have recently emerged as an alternative to GANs due to their strong image priors, stable training, and high-fidelity generation. DiffFace [ 29 ] introduces an identity-conditioned DDPM and applies identity, semantic, and gaze guidance during sampling. However, the required gradient-based guidance and iterative denoising make inference expensive. DiffSwap [ 56 ] formulates face swapping as 3D-aware masked diffusion, using facial landmarks and masks to preserve target pose and expression. It also introduces midpoint
estimation to apply identity supervision without differentiating through the complete sampling trajectory.
blocks.zh:
以传播为主的面相交换方法 传播模式由于具有强烈的图像前传,稳定的训练,以及高可靠性的生成,最近作为GAN的替代品出现了. DiffFace [29] 引入了具有身份条件的DDPM,并在采样过程中应用身份,语义,目视指导. 然而,所需的基于梯度的指导和迭代调试使推论变得昂贵。 DiffSwap [56] 将面部换成3D-意识的蒙面扩散,使用面部地标和面具来保存目标姿势和表情. 还引入了中点
估计采用身份监督,不通过完整的取样轨迹加以区分。

blocks.en: REFace [ 2 ] trains latent diffusion as a conditional inpainting model and unrolls several differentiable DDIM steps during training to apply identity and perceptual losses to estimated clean images. It further uses CLIP-feature disentanglement and semantic mask shuffling to support face, head, and regional swapping. FaceAdapter [ 18 ] adapts a pretrained Stable Diffusion model by explicitly separating identity, spatial, and attribute conditions. It maps source face embeddings into cross-attention tokens, while target landmarks, background, and CLIP features provide structural and appearance guidance.
blocks.zh: REFace [2] 将潜在扩散作为有条件的涂装模型进行训练,并在训练中不滚动几个不同的DDIM步骤,将身份和知觉损失应用于估计的清洁图像. 它进一步使用CLIP-feature脱钩和语义面具洗牌支持面部,头部,以及区域互换. FaceAdapter [18]通过明确区分身份,空间,和属性条件来调整一个预先训练的稳定扩散模型. 它将源头图案嵌入到交叉意向符中,而目标地标,背景,和CLIP特征则提供结构和外观指导.

blocks.en:
More recent work, DreamID [ 52 ] , revisits the idea of CSCS [ 22 ] by introducing the triplet ID group, which allows existing data to be used as ground truth for face swaps.
They build on SD-Turbo [ 42 ] , which enables one-step generation.
In comparison, our method does not require a distilled model and can make use of a multi-step diffusion model.
This makes our approach more general and, in particular, allows us to use the larger FLUX model [ 4 ] and the recent PuLID [ 17 ] for better identity conditioning. Unfortunately, neither the code of DreamID nor its weights have been released, so a comparison with their model is unavailable.
APPLE [ 26 ] further studies the construction of triplet data supervision, noting that the teacher used in DreamID leads to limited target attribute preservation. APPLE trains a diffusion teacher with conditional deblurring and attribute-aware inversion to generate pseudo-labels that result in better target attribute preservation, and subsequently trains a student on the resulting pseudo-triplets. While DreamID presents a one-step model, it requires a distilled model for initialisation. APPLE presents a high-quality but multi-step model that requires an order of magnitude larger training budget than ALADDIN. Our model is one-step, preserves target attributes, and is not limited to a distilled pre-trained initialisation.
blocks.zh:
更近期的作品DreamID [52],通过引入三重ID组来重新审视CSCS [22]的想法,这使得现有的数据可以用作面值互换的地面真相.
它们建立在SD-Turbo[42]上,它使一步一代成为可能.
相比之下,我们的方法不需要蒸馏模型,可以使用多步骤扩散模型.
这使得我们的方法更加笼统,特别是使我们能够使用更大的FLUX模型[4]和最近的PulID[17]来更好的身份条件. 不幸的是,DreamID的代码及其重量都没有发布,因此无法与它们的模型进行比较.
Apple [26] 进一步研究三重数据监理的构建,注意到DreamID中使用的老师导致目标属性保存有限. APPLE培训一个具有有条件的去blurring和属性意识反转功能的传播教师,以生成可以更好的目标属性保存的伪标签,随后在由此产生的伪三联体上培训一个学生. 在梦中 ID呈现一个单步模型,它需要一个蒸馏模型进行初始化. APPLE提供了一个高质量但跨步骤的模型,需要比ALADDIN更大的数量级培训预算. 我们的模型是单步的,保留了目标属性,并不限于蒸馏的预训练初始化.

blocks.en: This choice of the discriminator allows us to make use of strong features from a pretrained diffusion model. Blocks at different depths of the model already encode different levels of abstraction. More importantly, these are not generic features: the diffusion model was trained to generate images including faces, so its activations already encode what a plausible face looks like at every scale, from global geometry to skin microtexture. A discriminator built on top of them reuses that prior for free instead of having to learn it from the adversarial signal alone. Moreover, discriminative backbones trained for classification are known to rely predominantly on texture [ 14 ] , whereas classifiers derived from diffusion models exhibit a shape bias close to natural human comprehension [ 25 ] . This argument motivates [ 41 ] to use generative features over a frozen discriminative backbone, DINO [ 6 , 36 ] , as in [ 42 ] .
blocks.zh: 这种对歧视者的选择使我们能够利用预先训练的传播模式的强烈特征。 在模型的不同深度的块已经编码了不同层次的抽象. 更重要的是,这些不是通用的特征: 扩散模型被训练成生成图像,包括面部, 所以它的激活已经编码了 任何尺度的假面, 从全球几何到皮肤微纹理。 一个歧视者建在他们上面的再利用是免费的,而不是仅仅从对抗信号中学习。 此外,众所周知,经过分类培训的歧视性骨干主要依赖纹理[14],而从扩散模型中得出的分类器则显示出接近自然人类理解的形状偏差[25]。 这一论点促使[41]在冻结的歧视性骨干上使用基因特征,DINO[6,36],如[42]。

For example, if the pair ( x src , x tgt ) (x_{\mathrm{src}},x_{\mathrm{tgt}}) shares the same identity, then x tgt x_{\mathrm{tgt}} is itself the correct answer. In this case, we can add a reconstruction loss: ℒ rec ​ ( x ^ , x tgt ) = d ⁡ ( x ^ , x tgt ) , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rec}}(\hat{x},x_{\mathrm{tgt}})=d(\hat{x},x_{\mathrm{tgt}}), (6) where d d is a distance metric, for example the ℓ 1 \ell_{1} or ℓ 2 \ell_{2} distance. Empirically, we find that Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) [ 55 ] leads to better quantitative results than ℓ 1 \ell_{1} .

Implementation details We follow the architecture of APPLE [ 26 ] and initialise the generator with FLUX.1-Krea-dev [ 4 ] , using PuLID [ 17 ] as the identity encoder and OminiControl [ 46 ] as the attribute-conditioning branch.
The same frozen FLUX.1-Krea-dev transformer supplies the discriminator features of Equation 3 .
We train LoRA adapters of rank 64 64 on the attention projections of all transformer blocks, together with PuLID’s cross-attention layers, on top of the frozen backbone, and all experiments run at a resolution of 512 × 512 512\times 512 .
For ℒ id \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{id}} , we use an ArcFace [ 9 ] model trained on Glint360K [ 24 ] . Following REFace [ 2 ] and APPLE [ 26 ] , the source image is masked before it enters the identity encoder, so that target attributes do not leak into the embedding. For ℒ id \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{id}} , the masked images are resized to 112 × 112 112\times 112 without further alignment. We report two kinds of model: teacher and student. Increasing the reconstruction weight λ rec \lambda_{\mathrm{rec}} of the student trades identity transfer against realism and target preservation, so we report triplet-trained students with λ rec ∈ { 1 , 3 , 7 } \lambda_{\mathrm{rec}}\in\{1,3,7\} to expose this trade-off. blocks.en: Dataset filtration Our face swapping model is trained on VGGFace2-HQ [ 8 ] and Arc2Face [ 37 ] . Both datasets provide several images per identity, which the same identity and triplet groups require. Batches are drawn from Arc2Face and VGGFace2-HQ in a 4:1 ratio, and after the filtering described below the training set contains 4.1M images of 540K identities. They also need filtering, since they contain low-quality images and since some identities mix photographs of different people. We first discard low-quality images using the AES predictor [ 43 ] with a threshold of 5.1 5.1 as in [ 26 ] . To clean an identity, we define its anchor as the face with the highest average identity similarity to the others, sort the remaining faces by their similarity to that anchor, and keep only those whose similarity to it lies between 0.6 0.6 and 0.95 0.95 ; a face is admitted only if its similarity to every already accepted face is below 0.95 0.95 to avoid duplicate images.
blocks.zh: 数据集过滤 我们的换脸模式在VGGFace2-HQ[8]和Arc2Face[37]上训练. 两个数据集都提供了每个身份的多个图像,而同一身份和三胞胎组都需要这些图像. Batches从Arc2Face和VGFace2-HQ以4:1的比例绘制,在下面描述的过滤后,训练集包含4.1M的540K身份图像. 它们也需要过滤,因为它们含有低质量的图像,而且有些身份混合了不同人的照片. 我们首先使用AES预测器[43]丢弃低质量图像,阈值为[26]中的5.1.5.1。 为了清理身份,我们将它的锚定型为与其他人具有最高平均身份相似性的面孔,用它们与锚的相似性来排序其余的面孔,并且只保留其相似度在0.6至0.95 0.95之间的面孔;只有在面孔与每个已被接受的面孔的相似度低于0.95 0.95时才被承认,以避免图像重复.

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol We follow the protocol of [ 2 , 52 , 26 ] and evaluate on the fixed list of 1,000 1{,}000 source–target pairs from FFHQ [ 27 ] used by REFace, reporting four aspects of a swap. Realism is measured by the Fréchet distance [ 20 ] between CLIP ViT-B/32 features [ 30 ] of the 1,000 1{,}000 generated images and of all 70,000 70{,}000 FFHQ images at 512 × 512 512\times 512 , computed with the evaluation code released with REFace [ 2 ] . We refer to it as FID throughout. Identity transfer is measured in two ways: the cosine similarity between the identity embeddings of the generated and the source face, and retrieval accuracy, obtained by ranking all source faces by that similarity and reporting how often the correct one appears first (Top-1) or within the first five (Top-5). Following [ 2 ] , we mask out the region outside the face in both images before extracting these embeddings, so that shared background and hair cannot affect the score. Target preservation is measured by the ℓ 2 \ell_{2} distance between the generated and target images in head pose, estimated with Hopenet [ 40 ] , and in expression, estimated with Deep3DFace [ 10 ] . Both are applied to the whole frame without face detection, and both are independent of the estimators used for training. To provide a fair comparison, we generate face swaps with the available baseline models and score them under our protocol.

blocks.en: Comparison with one-step methods Every one of our models improves on MegaFS and E4S in all four metrics. HiFiFace is beaten in all four by our Teacher and by Student λ=1 , and SimSwap, FaceDancer, and InfoSwap are beaten in all four by Student λ=3 . blocks.en: Training cost against APPLE The same gap appears in the training budget. APPLE trains its teacher on 1.04M image pairs and its student on a further 0.24M, reporting 12.78 days on four A6000 GPUs, of which 5.78 are spent generating pseudo-triplets offline with the 28-step teacher. ALADDIN uses 0.10M pairs for the teacher, trained in about 4.5 hours of wall-clock time on four H100 GPUs, and 0.015M for the student, which needs no offline generation stage because the teacher is itself one-step. This is more than a tenfold reduction in training data at matching quality.

blocks.en: Qualitative comparison Figure 3 compares our method against the selected strong baselines across six axes. The first two probe the realism of the swap: an unusual target hairstyle (row 1) and a large source–target age gap (row 2). The remaining four measure the preservation of target attributes, namely glasses, tattoo, head pose and facial expression. GAN-based methods introduce severe artifacts, significantly worsening realism. CSCS is prone to copy-paste behaviour with little adaptation to the target. InSwapper transfers identity well, but its fidelity is limited by the 128 × \times 128 resolution of the original model. InfoSwap struggles to retain the target’s attributes: it alters the hair in row 1, renders the glasses transparent in row 3, and perturbs the pose and expression in rows 5 and 6. Diffusion-based baselines achieve superior realism and attribute preservation to the GAN-based methods. Nevertheless, REFace produces unrealistic texture and under-transfers the source identity in most rows. APPLE is the strongest baseline overall. However, it is also prone to artifacts in challenging scenarios (transparent lenses in row 3). After triplet training, ALADDIN matches APPLE’s realism and attribute preservation at a fraction of its inference cost. Moreover, short training time allows us to flexibly choose the operating point via the LPIPS reconstruction coefficient λ rec \lambda_{\text{rec}} . Higher values improve realism and attribute retention at the cost of identity transfer, as seen between our two columns.
blocks.zh: 定性比较 图3将我们的方法与六个轴线上选定的强基线进行比较。 前两段探索互换的现实主义:一种不寻常的目标发型(第1行)和巨大的源-目标年龄差距(第2行). 其余四个测量目标属性的保存,即眼镜,纹身,头部姿势和面部表情. 以GAN为基础的方法引入了严重的文物,大大恶化了现实主义. CSCS容易出现抄袭行为,很少适应目标. InSwapper转录身份很好,但其忠诚度受到原型号128×\time128分辨率的限制. InfoSwap为保留目标属性而挣扎:它会改变第1行的头发,使第3行的眼镜透明化,并使第5和第6行的姿势和表情受到干扰. 基于扩散的基线实现优越的现实主义,并将保存归属于基于GAN的方法. 尽管如此,REFace还是产生了不切实际的纹理,并在大多数行中将源身份转让不足. Apple是总体最强的基准. 然而,它也容易在具有挑战性的情景中出现文物(第3行中的透明镜头). 经过三胞胎训练后,ALADDIN与APPLE的现实主义和属性保全相匹配,其推论成本只有一小部分. 此外,培训时间很短,我们可以通过LPIPS重建系数来灵活选择操作点。 更高的价值提高了现实主义和属性保留,以牺牲身份转移为代价,我们两栏之间可以看到这一点。

blocks.en: Latent discriminator The central design choice in our adversarial training is that the discriminator reads the frozen teacher’s activations rather than the latent itself. To isolate its effect, we train on cross-identity batches only, replace the teacher features h ( 1 ) , … , h ( K ) h^{(1)},\dots,h^{(K)} in Equation 3 with the noised latent z σ z_{\sigma} , and leave everything else unchanged. FID then degrades from 5.50 5.50 to 20.46 20.46 , pose from 2.20 2.20 to 2.82 2.82 , and expression from 0.95 0.95 to 1.13 1.13 , while identity similarity rises from 0.49 0.49 to 0.53 0.53 . blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and limitations
blocks.zh: 5 结论和限制

blocks.en:
We presented ALADDIN, a one-step face swapper obtained by initialising the generator from a pretrained flow-matching model and training it adversarially. No distillation objective is needed: the pretrained flow model supplies the realism prior twice, as the generator’s initialisation and as the feature extractor of the discriminator.
ALADDIN is state-of-the-art among one-step methods, and it matches APPLE, the strongest multi-step baseline, in identity transfer, FID, and expression while improving on it in pose, while using one network evaluation instead of 28 28 and an order of magnitude less training data.
Our ablations isolate the design choice this rests on: the discriminator must read the intermediate activations of the frozen diffusion model rather than the latent itself, which supplies the realism prior that adversarial training alone does not. We further show that prior evaluation protocols score identity with an encoder several of the compared methods are trained against, and adopt one that is disjoint from all of them.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了ALADDIN,一个单步换脸器,它通过从预先训练的流量匹配模型中初始化发电机并进行对抗性训练而获得. 不需要提炼目标:预先训练的流体模型提供两次前的现实主义,作为发电机的初始化和歧视者的特征提取器。
ALADDIN是单步法中最先进的一种方法,它与APPLE(最强的多步基线)在身份转移、FID和表达方面相匹配,同时在姿势上有所改进,同时使用一个网络评价而不是28个28,培训数据的数量级较低。
我们将设计选择隔离开来:歧视者必须读取冷冻扩散模型的中间激活,而不是潜伏本身,而潜伏本身在对抗性训练本身不是真实的之前就提供了现实主义。 我们进一步表明,先前的评估协议用编码器对若干比较方法进行校对,并采用与所有方法脱节的方法。

Limitations and future work Our method inherits the failure modes of the field.
Identity transfer degrades on unusual source identities and on large age gaps.
Our model with the weakest target preservation additionally loses tattoos (see Figure 3 ).
Appendix C discusses these cases. Resolving them is open work for face swapping as a whole.

blocks.en: Appendix D Ethical considerations
blocks.zh: 附录D 道德考虑

blocks.en: Face swapping can be misused to produce non-consensual or deceptive imagery, and a one-step method lowers the cost of doing so at scale. Our interest in the problem comes from identity verification, where realistic swaps are needed to train and stress-test the systems that detect them, and from film production [ 35 ] . We train only on research datasets used throughout prior face-swapping work, and all qualitative examples use FFHQ images.
blocks.zh: 换脸可能被滥用来制作未经同意或欺骗性的图像,单步法可以降低规模化的换脸成本. 我们对这个问题的兴趣来自身份核查,需要现实的交换来培训和测试检测系统,以及电影制作[35]。 我们只培训在以往的扫脸工作中使用的研究数据集,所有定性实例都使用FFHQ图像.
